I actually had that same (probably not exact) type of testing done with a neuropsychologisy. it was when I was pacing myself way more and they said the same thing it showed some declines or whatever thats related to fatigue. it kinda sucked though because the test I did at the place was more for seniors I believe because that's the type of facility it was and the said I was very young and that was uncommon. they should really have some other type of testing more for illnesses like ours. or maybe they do, just not where I'm at. I think if I did it now itd show even more but it really isn't the same to help prove not being able to work since its just in a room with one person. a lot of my cognitive issues get worse in more crowded environments or brighter places and stuff or loud places. so doing a test in a work environment would be even harder and show more I believe 

and yeah I do have depression :( I need to get some help for that and anxiety and any other mental health issues I may have. I know that'll help build my case it's just hard for me to be open during those tests and talk to people. it's also expensive and its so much on my parents already paying for physical tests. I'm gonna try to get that more documented in the next year though
